basic_info.description: Built in 1955, this fully detached sunny Mid-Century Modern home sits on a wide tree-lined street in vibrant Bayview. The front exterior has been thoughtfully landscaped with drought-resistant hardscape and lush greenery, creating an inviting curb appeal. Beautiful architectural detail includes 2 skylights, newly refinished white oak hardwood & parquet floors, moldings, double paned windows & picture windows. Love to garden or cook with fresh fruit? The deep landscaped backyard/garden boasts a variety of fruit trees, some include apricot, cherry, peach & plum. The outdoor space is perfect for entertaining, relaxing & sunbathing. 3 bedrooms, 1 full bathroom, formal entry, formal living room with woodburning fireplace, formal dining room, eat-in kitchen, large 2 car garage with interior access, laundry area with new sink & washer/dryer, amazing storage, wine storage, spacious patio, backyard with mature trees, blooming plants, lush greenery, potted plants, new gravel & newly mulched. Front landscaped grounds with colorful & blooming plants.  Google Nest camera w/floodlight, garage myQ Garage door remote & myQ Smart camera, new roof in 2024, new thermostat, fresh interior paint in many areas, expansion potential in garage. Scenic views of Bayview Hill & twinkling City lights.
